states.narration: Two copies and three copies of the same expression can be counted together. Keep x+3 intact.
The common expression stays on the right. Its coefficient records the two original counts.
Evaluate only the coefficient sum: two plus three is five. The expression x+3 is unchanged.

editorial.title: Count copies of a whole expression
editorial.setup: Read x+3 as one shared unit, then simplify how many copies there are.
editorial.summary: Factoring preserves the shared structure; evaluation simplifies its coefficient. Neither step divides by x+3, so x=-3 is allowed too.
